scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a State Livestock Agency, State Livestock Board, or the State Animal Husbandry Department
State must formulate and notify a breeding policy for pigs before submitting the proposal for germplasm import
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance to states for importing exotic pig germplasm on a cost‑sharing basis (60:40 for most states, 90:10 for NER and Himalayan states) to develop superior cross‑bred pigs.
